# vCard & Event QR Code Generator

> Free, browser-based contact cards and calendar event invitations by Alex Garrido.

## App
- https://mralexgarrido.github.io/vCard-Generator/

## Capabilities
Create vCard 3.0 contact files and iCalendar 2.0 event files. Generate local QR codes, export PNG/SVG, present an enlarged QR, print a card, or create a designed contact-card/event-invitation PNG. Import common fields from one VCF/ICS entry. Use native file sharing where supported, with a download fallback.

Contact and event drafts autosave in the current browser. A local shelf holds up to 12 named copies, with rename, remove, and use-as-template controls. Event templates get fresh calendar identities. No accounts, tracking, server-side storage, API keys, or subscriptions.

## Limitations
Browser storage is not encrypted by the app, synced, or a permanent backup. Static QR codes do not update after printing. Camera and calendar compatibility vary. Recurrence, attendees, attachments, hosted contact pages, cloud sync, and scan analytics are not provided. Features on an unmerged branch are not yet live.
